page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the scan). Running head at top, "NOTÆ.", page number at top right. One column of running text, with no marginal notes. Arabic verse lines are set within the text column.

main_text.p: Quis autem à Iustino missus ad AlMondarum fuerit è Nonnosi apud Photium excerptis discimus, Abraham sc. Nonnosi patrem. Mawiah ergò ista quæ sub Valente & Valentiniano floruit, alia erit ab ista quæ Al-Mondari mater. Non dissimili tamen de causa & illa olim & postea AlMondarus infenso in partes Romanas animo fuit; ob Christianos sc. qui ejusdem cum Arabum Christianis sententiæ fuerant, duriùs tractatos. hac autem differentiâ, quòd sub Mawiah Arrianismi fautores Orthodoxos, sub AlMondaro Orthodoxi Iacobitarum hæresim amplexos persequerentur. Quæcunque autem fuerit Mawiah ista, ex eo quòd tunc temporis Sabæis[?] imperâsse dicatur, argumentum sumit Doctissimus vir Samuel Bochartus sententiæ suæ confirmandæ regnâsse apud Arabes fœminas, eruditissimi operis sui, l. 2. c. 26. Adductis ab ipso testimoniis liceat & alterum è Georgio Ebnol Amdi addere, cujus hæc in vita Reu (quem Argu vocat) sunt verba وفي ايام ارغو ملكت امراة مملكة سبا سنين[?] كثيرة وصار النسوان يملكون بعدها مملكة شبا الى ايام سليمان بن داوود i. e. Diebus Argu multos annos occupavit fœmina Regnum Sabæ, & post eam regnárunt ibi fœminæ usque ad tempus Salomonis filii Davidis. Quod quâ fide ab ipso tradıtum[?] sit nescio. Aliter senserunt Authores quos in texenda Regum Hamyarensium serie secuti sumus: illi enim unam tantum, Belkû nomine, quæ Salomone regnante floruerit, reginam memorant. Quod ad Mawiam, non alio jure quàm quod Regi nupta fuerat, rerum potitâ testantur qui eas ab ipsa post viri sui mortem administratas

page.notes: The Arabic lines are reproduced as printed; the first line's final word (سنين) and the Latin word after "Sabæ" are read with doubt. "Sabæis" in the running text is a doubtful reading of a word that is hard to make out at this scan resolution. "tradıtum" is the printed "traditum" with an unclear letter. Dark marks at the right edge are not printed text and are left out. The Arabic line-break spacing in the scan is not reproduced exactly.
